main_body: Hexagonal coffin drawn as a single tall slab: a tan-orange lid with a gold cross, narrowing toward the foot, with a dark brown outline
top_band: none; the head end has a thin dark brown cap at rows 1-3, then the lid slab (orange-brown) fills the whole body with no separate top band and front face
evidence: The coffin is a flat lid seen from above, with the cross on it and the outline tapering from shoulders to foot. Reading down the middle column, there is a thin dark cap, then the same orange-brown lid tone for about 28 rows, with a lighter strip near row 24 and a darker patch at the bottom right. No lighter top band is followed by a step and a front face. The only front hint is a few rows of darker tone at the foot. This matches the top-down slab in the guide, which has no front face, so it fails.

style.evidence: The outline is a dark brown that follows the wood, which is good. The shading is shallow, with about 3 wood tones (orange-brown, lighter tan, dark edge) plus a gold cross. The lid has large flat fills with only slight grain and a vertical split on the left, so it is thinner than the stall and well references. Each tile carries only a few colours, well below the reference density.
